review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its definitions against Mathlib. The new definitions are fullInclusion, restrictedNormLimitIso and several private helpers. All of them build on this library's own LevelCompact and RestrictedLevelCompactRep structures. I found no competing Mathlib concept for any of them. The one near-candidate is compactGroup_isIso_of_bijective, which shows that a continuous bijective homomorphism of compact Hausdorff additive groups is an isomorphism. It is a standalone theorem, not a competing definition or concept, so the rubric excludes it. It also reuses Mathlib's CompHausLike.isoOfBijective and has no Mathlib counterpart for CompHausAddCommGrp. I grepped Mathlib's Topology/Category and Topology/Algebra/Category directories and found no bijective-implies-iso lemma for CompHausAddCommGrp. The private lemmas fullNorm_map_coe and normDiagram_map_coe are parallel statements for different structures. They are not a duplicated concept. I am fairly confident there is nothing to report.
